headlines.title: Netflix doesn’t want investors to worry, despite recent shake-ups, layoffs
headlines.description: “Reminder, we are a streaming-first business. That is our core,” co-CEO Ted Sarandos said on the streamer’s third-quarter earnings call.

headlines.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss merger idea
headlines.description: Musk said he isn’t a member of either special committee or involved in the talks because he’s a conflicted party under securities regulations.

headlines.title: Spotify says it removed 50 million ‘slop’ and spam AI tracks this year
headlines.description: The company found that songs users frequently skipped or ignored consistently overlapped with artificially generated audio.

headlines.title: Oil prices whipsaw as markets weigh Middle East turmoil against uncertain demand
headlines.description: After hitting recent highs mid-morning, crude oil prices tumbled in the wake of weaker than expected housing data.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Online Returns Get Tougher: What You Can Do About It
headlines.description: Returning online purchases has become more expensive and more difficult so NBC's Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to break down everything you need to know before you shop as businesses rein in their return policies. Tips include employing the "BORIS" method by buying online and returning in-store.

headlines.title: Carnival Cruise Lines Introduces Unpopular Dynamic Pricing Model
headlines.description: If you’re thinking about taking a cruise, it could cost you more because at least one major cruise line is ready to introduce dynamic pricing, the practice of changing prices in response to real time demand and competition — and it comes just ahead of the holiday season. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY on Carnival Cruise Line’s move and what it could mean for the industry overall.

headlines.title: Top business leaders sound the alarm over skilled worker shortage
headlines.description: From the people who keep us safe on the roads to those who wire our homes and are building the infrastructure powering the AI boom, America needs skilled workers. But a new report finds that the nation isn’t doing enough to keep up with demand. NBC’s Christine Romans sits down exclusively with BlackRock’s Larry Fink, Ford’s Jim Farley, Google’s Ruth Porat and Carhartt’s Linda Hubbard, who have come together with an urgent message.

headlines.title: Neighboring Gas Stations Compete to Offer Lowest Prices
headlines.description: NBC’s Hallie Jackson runs through the Highs and Lows of the week on Sunday TODAY including the neighboring gas stations that went head-to-head to offer low prices in Georgia, the dad who took his daughters to see Olivia Rodrigo and rocked out even more than they did and more.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: CNN’s Christiane Amanpour to leave network after 43 years
headlines.description: “I’m very sorry to see her go, but I’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally,” CNN chief executive Mark Thompson said.

headlines.title: Tech stocks erase $1 trillion of wealth as oil surges to $110 for the first time since May
headlines.description: Tech stocks shed more than $1 trillion in value Friday, as the price of oil soared to its highest levels in five months.
